title: My Journey
outcome: A confirmed customer has one trusted, accessible place to understand the booking, payment and upcoming Umrah journey state without fabricated readiness or operational facts.
actor: Authenticated customer viewing only bookings and travellers within the customer account scope.
modules: Booking supplies the confirmed booking and commercial summary projection.
Payments supplies payment and instalment state without exposing provider-sensitive data.
Catalogue supplies immutable published journey facts referenced by the booking snapshot.
Traveller supplies customer-owned traveller identities and future readiness placeholders.
routes: My Journey list -> Confirmed booking dashboard
Booking dashboard -> Payment schedule and status
acceptance: The customer sees only account-owned bookings and receives a safe not-found response for foreign identifiers.
The dashboard presents booking reference, confirmation state, departure, stay, travellers, occupancy and immutable commercial totals truthfully.
Payment state, due-now, remaining balance and instalment schedule come from authoritative payment and booking projections.
Future document, visa and readiness capabilities appear only as explicit unavailable or coming-next placeholders, never fabricated completion states.
Loading, empty, unavailable, delayed-projection and recoverable-error states are complete and actionable.
The page preserves the approved NoorPath customer visual language, header and footer across desktop and mobile.
Keyboard navigation, visible focus, semantics, live status messaging, 44px targets, 200% text and reduced motion pass.
Landing, Discovery, Package Details, Plan, Booking and My Journey form a connected, non-orphaned customer route graph.
Support entry includes the booking reference and correlation context without leaking sensitive information.
Telemetry measures successful dashboard load, projection delay, error outcome and support entry without collecting unnecessary personal data.
exclusions: Document upload and review; owned by VS-12.
Live flight tracking, GPS group tracking, chat and orientation content.
Operator exception management; owned by VS-14.
Editable booking, traveller or payment state from the customer dashboard.
